dct_description_sm: Bahrain administrative level 0-3 boundaries (COD-AB) dataset version 01. This dataset is structured into 3 levels: - Admin 1: 4 Governorate - Admin 2: 180 Area - Admin 3: 499 Block Note: Base layer is the block level (admin3, 499 units, source columns blockno/bltext), with area (admin2, 180 units) and governorate (admin1, 4 units) built up via schema-join; root code is ISO2 'BH'. admin2 (area) has no source code of its own; codes for all three levels are generated in stage 4 (code-create). admin3 has no source name of its own; the block number (bltext) is used as its name. topo-tools schema-join 0.17.0 silently dropped admin2's own name columns when joining admin3 against an admin2 file already enriched with admin1 columns, because 5 of 180 area names repeat under two different governorates; admin2_name/admin2_name1 were restored manually via a largest-overlap DuckDB join. Dates associated with this dataset: - 16 November 2026: dataset reviewed for accuracy and completeness - 16 November 2026: valid for use by the humanitarian community Quality assured, configured, and published by [OCHA Field Information Services (FIS)](https://data.humdata.org/organization/ocha-fiss) and [HDX](https://data.humdata.org/organization/hdx). Part of the dataset: [Global Subnational Administrative Boundaries](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/cod-ab-global)
dct_publisher_sm: Bahrain Ministry of Municipalities Affairs & Urban Planning
